issues: The second dialogue excerpt combines Abinadi's introduction with the Lord's reported command, so its single speaker label (Abinadi) is ambiguous; the Lord is not shown as physically present.
The pestilence is foretold in 12:7, but 12:6–7 do not name Abinadi; that identification relies on preceding context rather than this scene's refs.
The dialogue includes the verse's em dash correctly, but avoid treating the predicted calamities as present events.
King Noah is identified as the addressee by linking the reported “thy life” prophecy in verses 10–12 to verse 3; that identification is contextual rather than explicit in this scene’s cited verses.
The speaker is labeled unidentified, although the preceding scenes identify Abinadi as the speaker in this ongoing exchange; this obscures continuity without asserting a conflicting identity.
